# Australian Environmental Education

> > Australian Environmental Education provides NSW curriculum-aligned environmental science programs and resources exploring Australian wildlife, ecosystems, and conservation.

The organization delivers Science Made Easy incursion programs to schools across NSW, covering topics from animal adaptations and dangerous species to geology and wetland ecosystems. Resources align with NESA Science and Technology K-6 and HSIE curriculum standards, emphasizing hands-on learning about Australia's unique biodiversity.

## Key Topics

- Australian wildlife and adaptations
- Environmental education programs
- NSW curriculum alignment (NESA)
- Dangerous Australian animals
- Native plant and animal habitats
- Wetland ecosystems
- Frog conservation
- Venomous species safety
- Science Made Easy incursions
- Wildlife-friendly gardens
- Animal safety statistics
- Marine animals
- Reptile ecology
- Paleogene mammals
- Conservation education

## School Programs & Incursions

- [AUSTRALIAN ENVIRONMENTAL EDUCATION](https://www.australianenvironmentaleducation.com.au): Homepage for environmental education programs and resources for students
- [Australian Animal Adaptations - Australian Environmental Education](https://www.australianenvironmentaleducation.com.au/science-made-easy/australian-animal-adventure): School incursion exploring local animal adaptations and wildlife protection
- [Dynamic Earth incursion explores earth forming processes.](https://www.australianenvironmentaleducation.com.au/science-made-easy/dynamic-earth-2): Geology incursion program covering plate tectonics and rocks for NSW schools

## Australian Wildlife & Adaptations

- [Plant and Animal Adaptations](https://www.australianenvironmentaleducation.com.au/education-resources/thriving-in-australia-plant-and-animal-adaptations): Australian plant and animal adaptations to harsh environments and fire
- [Dangerous Australian Animals: are they what you expect?](https://www.australianenvironmentaleducation.com.au/education-resources/dangerous-australian-animals): Wildlife statistics on animal-related deaths in Australia from 2008-2017
- [Life in the Paleogene - Australian Environmental Education](https://www.australianenvironmentaleducation.com.au/education-resources/life-in-the-paleogene-the-rise-of-mammals): Paleogene Period (66-23 mya) and Australian mammal evolution post-Gondwana
- [Water Bears are tardigrades, tiny are almost microscopic animals.](https://www.australianenvironmentaleducation.com.au/education-resources/water-bears): Tardigrades: extremophile microscopic animals surviving harsh conditions

## Conservation & Habitat Creation

- [What are Wetlands and why are they important?](https://www.australianenvironmentaleducation.com.au/education-resources/what-are-wetlands): Wetland ecosystems, Ramsar sites, and conservation importance in Australia
- [Create a frogs friendly backyard - Australian Environmental Education](https://www.australianenvironmentaleducation.com.au/education-resources/create-a-frogs-friendly-backyard): Guide to creating frog habitats with ponds and Frog Tubes in backyards
- [Create a sanctuary for native animals in your garden](https://www.australianenvironmentaleducation.com.au/education-resources/backyard-basics): Guide to creating wildlife-friendly gardens with native plants and habitats

## Science Education Resources

- [Science is the discovery of knowledge and a process to obtain it.](https://www.australianenvironmentaleducation.com.au/education-resources/what-is-science): Scientific method and systematic approach to discovering knowledge

## Optional

- [Acknowledgement of Country](https://www.australianenvironmentaleducation.com.au/about/acknowledgement-of-country): Recognition of First Nations peoples' connection to Country and biodiversity
